title: I mpli H ate V id: A Benchmark Dataset and Two-stage Contrastive Learning Framework for Implicit Hate Speech Detection in Videos
caption: Figure 2: The proposed method first extracts modality-specific features from text, images, and audio using dedicated encoders. It then aligns these features in a shared embedding space through cross-modal encoders with projection heads and supervised contrastive loss. Additionally, emotion, sentiment and caption features are also extracted.
